name: videodb
description: Video tools for agents from a hosted MCP server. Summarize a video and answer questions about it, search one video or a library by what is said or shown, cut clips and highlight reels, add burned-in subtitles, reframe for Shorts and Reels, and connect RTSP camera feeds for alerts. Results come back as playable stream links.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in to VideoDB in the browser (OAuth 2.1), no API key needed. Docs: https://docs.videodb.io
